purpose: Repair the pinned predecessor's adverse scope cycle without erasing adverse evidence, while preserving exact lineage, source/sense provenance, and evidence-channel separation.

channel_definitions.definition: A pinned source supports the bounded record in its stated sense and scope.
A discovery or context-review candidate that is not support.
A distinct surface competing for the same controlled concept and sense.
Positive evidence of a collision, defect, or nonequivalence retained independently of mass.
A declared evidence gap or unknown; not adverse and never imputed as zero or support.
A typed prohibition or hold directed at a claim, promotion, or action.

changes.exact_motivation: A scope gap is adverse evidence about the witness, but a veto semantically targets the full-equivalence claim, not the witness that supplies provenance. Redirecting the veto to an explicit claim node preserves both facts and removes the only directed cycle.
The predecessor node is typed as absence evidence. Retyping its relation prevents an absence/adverse collision while retaining the same endpoints and the readiness-limiting gap semantics.

motivation_catalog.text: Redirect claim-directed veto to an explicit claim node so the adverse provenance chain is acyclic.
Keep absence distinct from adverse evidence without changing its endpoints or hiding the gap.
Add typed metadata and exact lineage while retaining the complete predecessor payload.

alternatives.proposal: Delete the scope-gap node or both cycle edges.
alternatives.reason: Erases adverse evidence or its provenance.
Leaves the adverse record detached from the witness that exhibits it.

alternatives.proposal: Keep both edges and waive acyclicity.
alternatives.reason: Contradicts the preregistered typed-DAG requirement and defeats topological replay.

alternatives.proposal: Reverse the adverse edge so both relations point to the witness.
alternatives.reason: Misstates the direction of the witness exhibiting the scope gap.

alternatives.proposal: Treat missing branch rows as adverse evidence.
alternatives.reason: Conflates unknown or missing evidence with a positive adverse finding.

alternatives.proposal: Split the historical witness into multiple duplicate witness nodes.
alternatives.reason: Adds identity ambiguity when a single explicit claim target is sufficient.
